blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Cooperative perception improves autonomous driving by sharing complementary observations among vehicles and roadside infrastructure for 3D object detection. However, practical deployment is constrained by limited bandwidth and unreliable cooperation, where packet loss, transmission delay, and spatial misalignment jointly degrade the cooperative feature stream. Existing methods often reduce communication cost or compensate for one degradation type, leaving coupled disturbances insufficiently addressed.
To address this problem, we propose Sparse2comm, a bandwidth-efficient and robust cooperative 3D object detection framework that treats unreliable cooperation as progressive restoration over degraded cooperative features. Sparse Feature Encoding first encodes communication as randomly mask-sampled foreground features transmitted by collaborating agents, from which the ego vehicle reconstructs dense semantic representations. This sparse-to-dense mechanism learns to infer missing object-centric content from sparse observations, enabling ultra-low-bandwidth communication and packet-loss recovery within the same representation. On the semantically restored features, Latency-Aware Alignment predicts motion flow to compensate delayed messages, and Self-Calibrating Fusion estimates residual spatial offsets in a self-supervised manner before adaptive cross-agent fusion. Sparse2comm therefore restores semantic completeness, temporal consistency, and spatial alignment in an ordered pipeline.
Extensive experiments on DAIR-V2X, OpenV2V, and V2V4Real show that Sparse2comm maintains competitive clean accuracy and consistently improves robustness under individual and mixed real-world degradations. Compared with the selective feature communication baseline Where2comm, Sparse2comm improves mixed-setting AP@0.5/AP@0.7 by +20.15/+11.79, +12.66/+11.07, and +15.36/+12.61 on the three datasets, respectively. The source code is available at https://github.com/yanglei18/Sparse2comm .

blocks.en: Cooperative perception has emerged as a key paradigm for enhancing autonomous driving safety, particularly in complex urban scenes where occlusion, restricted fields of view, and limited sensing range constrain ego-vehicle perception. By enabling an ego vehicle to exchange complementary observations with collaborating agents, including nearby vehicles and roadside units (RSUs), cooperative perception provides a more complete understanding of the surrounding environment and improves the reliability of 3D object detection in safety-critical scenarios [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 ] . However, moving from this promise to real-world deployment requires cooperative features to be both bandwidth-efficient and robust to unreliable communication and calibration. Current C-V2X links typically provide less than 10 Mbps [ 7 ] , making it impractical to transmit raw point clouds or dense feature maps at high frame rates. Although feature compression and object-level communication reduce data volume [ 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 ] , excessive compression may remove discriminative semantic cues and degrade detection reliability. Beyond this bandwidth constraint, cooperative messages are further affected by three major robustness degradations. Packet loss corrupts transmitted features under interference, congestion, and unstable wireless links [ 6 ] ; even a 5% packet loss can reduce cooperative perception accuracy by nearly 37% [ 12 ] . Transmission delay introduces temporal asynchrony between collaborator-side and ego-vehicle observations, especially for moving objects whose locations change rapidly across frames [ 13 , 14 , 15 ] . Spatial misalignment arises from GNSS multipath effects, sensor drift, and calibration errors, causing collaborator features to be projected to inaccurate positions in the ego-vehicle coordinate frame [ 16 ] . These factors often co-occur in complex scenes and jointly degrade the cooperative feature stream before fusion, making received messages sparse, incomplete, temporally stale, and spatially biased.
blocks.zh: 合作观念已成为加强自主驾驶安全的一个关键范例,特别是在复杂的城市景点,其中隔离、限制视野和有限的感知范围限制了自我车辆的认知。 通过让自负飞行器能够与包括附近车辆和路边装置在内的协作物剂交换补充观测结果,合作感知提供了对周围环境的更完整的了解,并提高了安全关键情景中3D物体探测的可靠性[1,2,3,4,5,6]. 然而,从这一承诺走向现实世界部署需要合作性特征既具有带宽效率,又健全到不可靠的通信和校正。 目前的C-V2X链路通常提供不到10 Mbps [7],因此以高帧速率传送生点云或密集地物图是不切实际的. 虽然特征压缩和对象级通信降低了数据量[8,9,10,11],但过度压缩可能会去除歧视性语义提示并降低检测可靠性. 除了这一带宽限制外,合作信息还受到三个主要强性退化的影响。 包丢失在干扰,拥堵,和不稳定的无线链接下腐蚀了传输的特性[6];即使5%的包丢失,合作感知精度也会降低近37% [12]. 传输延迟引入了协作方和自制车辆观测之间的时间同步,特别是对于位置迅速跨帧变化的移动物体而言[13、14、15]。 空间错位源于全球导航卫星系统的多路径效应、传感器漂移和校准出错,导致合作者特征投射到自负-车辆坐标架上不准确的位置[16]。 这些因素往往在复杂的场景中共同出现,在聚变前共同降解合作特征流,使收到的信息稀少,不完整,时间僵化,空间偏差.

blocks.en: Existing studies have made important progress on individual aspects of this problem. For bandwidth constraints, selective communication methods transmit only informative regions or compact object representations. For example, Where2comm [ 8 ] uses spatial confidence maps to share critical feature regions, while V2X-PC [ 9 ] clusters points into compact packages to preserve object structure. For packet loss, recent works explore feature recovery and history-aided reconstruction. V2X-INCOP [ 17 ] , for instance, leverages temporal redundancy to restore corrupted or missing cooperative messages. For temporal asynchrony, trajectory or flow-based methods compensate delayed messages using historical context [ 13 , 14 , 15 ] . For spatial misalignment and noisy cooperation, alignment-based and robust communication approaches refine relative poses, aggregate motion-aware features, or perform uncertainty-aware asynchronous fusion [ 18 , 19 , 20 ] . However, most existing methods are designed around either communication reduction or a specific degradation type. In real deployments, these factors are coupled: aggressive compression can amplify the impact of packet loss, delayed messages can worsen spatial inconsistency for moving objects, and inaccurate poses can make otherwise informative features harmful during fusion. Therefore, robust cooperative perception should not treat communication efficiency, packet-loss recovery, temporal alignment, and spatial calibration as isolated remedies. It requires an ordered restoration process that progressively recovers semantic completeness, temporal consistency, and spatial alignment from the same degraded feature stream.
blocks.zh: 现有的研究在这个问题的个别方面已取得重大进展。 对于带宽限制,选择性的通信方法只传输信息区域或紧凑对象表示. 例如,Where2comm [8]使用空间置信地图来共享关键地物区域,而V2X-PC [9]集群点入紧凑包来保存对象结构. 近期的作品探索恢复和历史援助重建。 例如,V2X-INCOP [17] 利用时间冗余恢复被损坏或缺失的合作信息。 对于时间同步法、轨迹法或流取法,利用历史背景来补偿被延迟的信息[13、14、15]。 对于空间错位和吵闹的合作,基于对齐和强力的通信方法可细化相对外观,聚合运动-意识特征,或进行对不确定性的认知同步聚变[18,19,20]. 然而,大多数现有方法都围绕着减少通信量或特定的降解类型来设计。 在实际部署中,这些因素是相加的:积极的压缩可以扩大包丢失的影响,延迟的信息可以使移动对象的空间不一致性恶化,不准确的姿势可以使本来信息丰富的特征在聚变过程中变得有害. 因此,强有力的合作观念不应将通信效率、数据包损失恢复、时间调整和空间校准视为孤立的补救办法。 它需要有序的恢复过程,逐步恢复语义的完整性、时间一致性和同一退化地物流的空间相接性。

blocks.en:
To address this gap, we propose Sparse2comm, a bandwidth-efficient and robust cooperative 3D object detection framework that treats unreliable cooperation as progressive restoration over degraded cooperative features. In this formulation, communication loss, temporal asynchrony, and spatial misalignment are not treated as independent disturbances. Instead, the received cooperative message is regarded as a degraded observation of an underlying cooperative feature state: it is sparse due to bandwidth constraints, incomplete due to packet loss, temporally stale due to transmission delay, and spatially biased due to localization or calibration errors. The objective is to recover a compact, semantically complete, temporally synchronized, and spatially calibrated cooperative representation before final detection.
To instantiate this restoration paradigm, Sparse2comm organizes Sparse Feature Encoding, Latency-Aware Alignment, and Self-Calibrating Fusion into a dependent sparse-to-aligned restoration pipeline. Sparse Feature Encoding (SFE) first encodes communication as randomly mask-sampled foreground features transmitted by collaborating agents, from which the ego vehicle reconstructs dense semantic representations. By training the ego vehicle to infer missing object-centric content from sparse foreground observations, SFE turns bandwidth reduction and packet-loss recovery into the same sparse-to-dense restoration problem. Given the semantically restored features from SFE, Latency-Aware Alignment (LAA) predicts motion flow from temporal collaborator features to compensate for transmission delay and synchronize cooperative features with the ego-vehicle timestamp. This second stage is placed after SFE because temporal alignment is more reliable when object-centric semantic content has been partially recovered. After temporal synchronization, Self-Calibrating Fusion (SCF) estimates residual spatial offsets in a self-supervised manner and refines adaptive cross-agent fusion. Placing SCF after LAA helps separate pose-induced offsets from temporal staleness, allowing final fusion to operate on both temporally synchronized and spatially calibrated features. These stages are not independent add-ons: SFE restores semantic completeness from sparse and lossy observations, LAA restores temporal consistency on recovered features, and SCF restores spatial alignment after temporal synchronization.

为了弥补这一差距,我们提议采用Sparse2comm,这是一个带宽高效和强有力的合作三维物体检测框架,将不可靠的合作视为逐步恢复已退化的合作特征。 在这种表述中,通信损失、时间同步和空间错位不被视为独立的扰动。 相反,收到的合作信息被视为对一个基本合作特征状态的退化观测:由于带宽限制,信息很少,由于包丢失而不完整,由于传输延迟而暂时停滞,以及由于本地化或校正出错而造成空间偏差。 目标是在最终检测前恢复一个紧凑,精密,时间同步,空间校正的合作代表.

blocks.en: Extensive experiments on DAIR-V2X [ 1 ] , OpenV2V [ 21 ] , and V2V4Real [ 22 ] demonstrate that Sparse2comm maintains competitive clean accuracy and generalizes across vehicle–infrastructure, simulated vehicle–vehicle, and real-world vehicle–vehicle cooperative perception scenarios. Under the mixed robustness setting with packet loss, transmission delay, and spatial misalignment, Sparse2comm improves over the strongest prior methods by +15.75/+9.37, +7.13/+4.11, and +11.11/+7.34 AP@0.5/AP@0.7 on the three datasets, respectively. Compared with the representative selective communication baseline Where2comm [ 8 ] , the corresponding mixed-setting gains are +20.15/+11.79, +12.66/+11.07, and +15.36/+12.61 AP@0.5/AP@0.7, while Sparse2comm uses only 1.0% relative feature bandwidth. These results show that Sparse2comm provides a strong trade-off among detection accuracy, robustness, and communication efficiency.

blocks.en: II Related Works
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Ego-centric 3D Object Detection
blocks.zh: II-A 以Ego为中心 三维对象检测

blocks.en: Accurate 3D object detection is a fundamental capability for autonomous driving. Existing ego-centric detectors are commonly developed around sensing modality and spatial representation. Vision-based methods [ 23 , 24 , 25 ] estimate 3D object geometry from monocular or multi-view images, offering a low-cost perception solution but remaining sensitive to depth ambiguity, illumination changes, and adverse weather. Recent camera-based BEV frameworks [ 26 , 27 , 28 , 29 ] lift image features into a unified bird’s-eye-view space, which makes cross-view spatial reasoning more explicit. LiDAR-based detectors [ 30 , 31 , 32 ] , represented by VoxelNet [ 30 ] , SECOND [ 31 ] , and PointPillars [ 32 ] , exploit accurate geometric measurements through voxel or pillar representations. Multi-modal detectors [ 33 , 34 , 35 ] further combine LiDAR and camera cues to integrate appearance and geometry.
blocks.zh: 精确3D物体检测是自主驾驶的基本能力. 现有的以自我为中心的探测器通常围绕感知方式和空间代表进行开发。 基于视觉的方法[23,24,25]从单相或多相视图像中估计出3D物体几何,提供了一个低成本的感知解决方案,但对深度模糊,发光变化和恶劣天气保持敏感. 最近基于相机的BEV框架 [26, 27, 28, 29] 将图像特征提升到一个统一的鸟眼视野空间中,这使得交叉视野空间推理更加清晰. 基于LiDAR的探测器[30,31,32],由VoxelNet [30],second [31]和PointPillers[32]代表,通过Voxel或界桩表示法利用准确的几何测量. 多式联运探测器[33,34,35]进一步结合了LiDAR和相机提示来整合外观和几何.

blocks.en: Although these ego-centric detectors substantially improve local perception, they still operate under a single-platform sensing assumption. Objects hidden by occlusion, distant traffic participants, and complex intersection layouts can remain unobservable from one viewpoint, regardless of the local detector architecture. These limitations motivate cooperative perception, where vehicles, roadside units, and other collaborating agents exchange complementary observations to extend the effective perception range and reduce blind spots. This shift also introduces communication and reliability constraints that are absent in purely ego-centric detection.
blocks.zh: 虽然这些以自负为中心的探测器大大提高了局部感知,但它们仍然在单平面感知假设下运行. 被隐蔽所隐藏的物体,远方的交通参与者,以及复杂的相交布局,无论当地探测器架构如何,从一个角度来说,仍然无法观察. 这些限制促使人们产生合作感想,即车辆、路边单位和其他协作人员交流补充观察,以扩大有效感想范围并减少盲点。 这种转变还引入了纯粹以自我为中心的检测中缺乏的沟通和可靠性限制。

blocks.en: II-B Cooperative Perception
blocks.zh: II-B 合作观点

blocks.en: Cooperative perception has developed rapidly with the emergence of V2X benchmarks, including simulated datasets such as V2X-Sim [ 36 ] and OPV2V [ 21 ] , system-level simulation platforms for collaborative autonomous driving [ 5 ] , real-world vehicle–infrastructure datasets such as DAIR-V2X [ 1 ] and V2X-Seq [ 4 ] , and recent real-world V2V/V2X or multi-modal datasets [ 22 , 37 , 38 ] . These benchmarks have shifted the field from isolated ego perception to collaborative scene understanding, and they also expose practical constraints caused by limited bandwidth, unreliable transmission, and imperfect localization.
blocks.zh: 随着V2X基准的出现,合作感得到迅速发展,包括模拟数据集,如V2X-Sim [36]和OPV2V [21],协作自主驾驶的系统级模拟平台 [5],现实世界车辆-基础设施数据集,如DAIR-V2X [1]和V2X-Seq [4],以及近期真实世界V2V/V2X或多模式数据集 [22,37,38]. 这些基准将领域从孤立的自负感转向了合作场景理解,它们也暴露出由于带宽有限,传输不可靠,局部化不完善而导致的实际限制.

blocks.en: Existing cooperative methods are commonly organized into early, late, and intermediate fusion. Early fusion preserves rich raw observations but incurs heavy communication, whereas late fusion is efficient but discards dense spatial evidence before cross-agent reasoning. Intermediate fusion exchanges feature representations and has become a practical balance between accuracy and bandwidth. Representative methods include feature-level fusion and message-passing approaches [ 39 , 40 , 41 ] , distillation or transformer-based cooperative fusion [ 42 , 43 , 44 , 45 ] , and communication-aware variants [ 8 , 46 , 10 , 47 , 48 , 11 ] . Most of these methods are evaluated under relatively reliable feature exchange, where received messages are assumed to be usable after transmission.
blocks.zh: 现有的合作方法通常分为早期、后期和中间聚变。 早期聚变保存了丰富的原始观测结果,但发生重力通信,而后期聚变是高效的,但在交叉物剂推理之前抛弃了密集的空间证据. 中间聚变交流以表示为特色,并已成为精度和带宽之间的实际平衡. 具有代表性的方法包括地物级聚变和通电方法[39,40,41],蒸馏或变压器型合作聚变[42,43,44,45],以及通信感知变体[8,46,10,47,48,11]. 这些方法大多是在相对可靠的特征交换下评价的,其中收到的电文被认为在传输后可以使用。

blocks.en: Communication efficiency is a key requirement for practical cooperative perception over bandwidth-limited V2X links. Selective, pragmatic, and object-aware methods reduce transmitted data by sharing informative regions, compact object messages, or hybrid intermediate-late representations [ 8 , 9 , 49 , 47 , 48 , 11 ] . These methods show that sparse communication can greatly reduce transmission cost. However, sparsification and packet loss both remove feature content from the cooperative stream, so message compactness and message recoverability are tightly coupled. This coupling suggests that communication-efficient representations should also be recoverable under missing observations.
blocks.zh: 通信效率是对带宽有限的V2X链接的实际合作感知的关键要求. 选择性、实用性和对对象的认识方法通过共享信息区域、紧凑对象信息或混合中间迟交表示[8、9、49、47、48、11]减少传输数据。 这些方法表明,很少的通信可以大大降低传输成本. 然而,垃圾邮件和包装丢失都从合作流中删除了特征内容,因此信息紧凑性和信息可回收性紧密相联。 这种组合表明,在缺失的观察中,通信效率高的表述也应当可以收回。

blocks.en: Robustness to communication and calibration errors is another important direction. Prior works have studied lossy or interrupted communication [ 50 , 17 , 12 ] , transmission delay and temporal asynchrony [ 14 , 15 , 13 ] , and spatial misalignment caused by localization or pose errors [ 18 , 16 ] . More recent robust cooperative perception methods further explore motion-aware feature aggregation and uncertainty-aware asynchronous fusion [ 19 , 20 ] . Most of these methods target a specific degradation type. In practice, these disturbances often occur together, so robustness needs to be examined under packet loss, delay, spatial misalignment, and their coupled setting rather than as isolated cases.
blocks.zh: 强力通通和校正出错是另一个重要方向. 先前的作品研究了丢失或中断的通信[50,17,12],传输延迟和时间同步[14,15,13],以及由本地化造成的空间错配或造成出错[18,16]. 更近期的强效合作感知方法进一步探索了运动意识特征聚合和不确定性意识同步聚变[19,20]. 这些方法大多针对特定的降解类型. 在实践中,这些扰动往往同时发生,因此需要根据包丢失、延误、空间错位及其相接的设置,而不是孤立的情况来审查稳健性。

blocks.en: III-C Sparse Feature Encoding
blocks.zh: III- C 空间特性编码

blocks.en: Sparse Feature Encoding serves as the first restoration stage and provides the core mechanism for both low-bandwidth communication and packet-loss recovery. Different from selective communication methods that transmit selected foreground responses [ 8 ] , SFE encodes communication as randomly mask-sampled foreground features. The collaborating agent sends only a small subset of object-centric BEV patches, and the ego vehicle reconstructs dense semantic representations from these sparse observations. In this view, bandwidth reduction is not a post-hoc compression step. It becomes a sparse-to-dense reconstruction problem, where intentionally omitted patches and accidentally lost packets are handled as missing foreground observations under the same reconstruction mechanism.
blocks.zh: Sparse Feature Encoding是第一个恢复阶段,为低波段通讯和包丢失恢复提供了核心机制. 不同于选择性的通信方法传输所选的展望响应[8],SPE将通信编码为随机的遮罩-抽样的展望特征. 合作者只发送了一小片以物体为中心的BEV补丁,自负飞行器从这些稀少的观测中重建出密集的语义表现. 在这种观点中,带宽的降低不是后热压缩步骤. 它成为一个稀有到紧张的重建问题,故意省略了补丁和意外丢失的包裹作为缺失的前地观测在同一个重建机制下处理.

blocks.en: III-C 1 Mask Sampling
blocks.zh: III-C 1 口罩取样

blocks.en: Mask Sampling minimizes transmission cost while preserving essential object-level cues. It takes the object-foreground BEV feature ℱ i t i \mathcal{F}_{i}^{t_{i}} as input and outputs an ultra-sparse feature map ℱ ~ i t i \widetilde{\mathcal{F}}_{i}^{t_{i}} that retains only partial foreground information. Different from global random masking, the proposed strategy restricts sampling to object regions and independently samples visible patches for each object instance. The random object-wise sampling is deliberately used as a missing-pattern generator: during training, the reconstruction network observes diverse visible patch subsets and learns to infer object-centric content from incomplete evidence rather than relying on fixed transmitted positions. This object-wise design reduces the risk of removing an entire object and introduces instance-level sparsity variation that improves robustness to communication uncertainty.

blocks.en: III-C 2 Feature Reconstruction
blocks.zh: III-C 2 特征重建

blocks.en: Feature Reconstruction is the semantic restoration component of SFE. It restores incomplete object-foreground features caused by intentional mask sampling and packet loss during transmission. Since both effects remove foreground patches from the received observation, they can be recovered by the same sparse-to-dense decoder. It adopts an encoder-decoder architecture that learns a reconstruction prior over object-centric BEV features.

blocks.en: The encoder consists of five ViT [ 52 ] blocks. Each received foreground patch is projected by a linear layer, augmented with positional encoding, and processed by the encoder to produce a high-dimensional embedding. Only patches indexed by V rec V_{\mathrm{rec}} are forwarded to the encoder, while masked or packet-lost patches are omitted, which keeps the computation compatible with sparse communication.

blocks.en: III-D Latency-Aware Alignment
blocks.zh: III-D 延迟通知对齐

blocks.en: After SFE restores semantic completeness, the recovered collaborator feature can still be temporally stale because it is generated at the collaborator timestamp rather than the ego timestamp. For moving objects, this temporal asynchrony appears as spatial displacement in the BEV plane and can degrade feature fusion even when the transmitted content has been reconstructed. Latency-Aware Alignment is therefore placed after SFE: it estimates motion flow from recent collaborator features and warps the recovered feature to the ego-vehicle timestamp, restoring temporal consistency before spatial calibration. The module decomposes this process into flow generation and temporal warping, as summarized in Fig. 5 .

blocks.en: We evaluate Sparse2comm on three cooperative perception datasets: DAIR-V2X [ 1 ] , OpenV2V [ 21 ] , and V2V4Real [ 22 ] . These datasets cover complementary cooperative settings, including vehicle–infrastructure cooperation, simulated vehicle–vehicle cooperation, and real-world vehicle–vehicle cooperation, allowing us to examine robustness beyond a single benchmark.
blocks.zh: 我们评价Sparse2comm的三个合作感知数据集:DEIR-V2X [1],OpenV2V [21],和V2V4Real [22]. 这些数据集涵盖互补的合作环境,包括车辆-基础设施合作、模拟车辆-车辆合作以及现实世界车辆-车辆合作,使我们能够审查超出单一基准的稳健性。

blocks.en: DAIR-V2X [ 1 ] is a large-scale vehicle–infrastructure cooperative perception dataset collected from real urban scenarios. It contains synchronized vehicle-side and infrastructure-side LiDAR-camera data with 3D annotations, and introduces the VIC3D task where detection must account for both temporal asynchrony and communication cost. We use DAIR-V2X as the primary benchmark for evaluating vehicle–infrastructure cooperative 3D object detection under bandwidth and robustness constraints.
blocks.zh: DAIR-V2X [1]是一个大型车辆-基础设施合作感知数据集,从真实的城市情景中收集. 它包含同步的车辆侧和基础设施侧LiDAR-相机数据,并附有3D说明,并引入了国际中心3D任务,其中检测必须兼顾时间同步和通信成本。 我们使用DAIR-V2X作为主要基准,在带宽和坚固性限制下评价车辆-基础设施合作3D物体检测。

blocks.en: OpenV2V [ 21 ] is an open simulated vehicle–vehicle cooperative perception benchmark built with CARLA and OpenCDA. It provides multi-agent sensor observations, accurate poses, and cooperative 3D annotations across diverse traffic scenarios, making it suitable for controlled evaluation of vehicle–vehicle feature fusion. We use OpenV2V to examine whether Sparse2comm generalizes to multi-agent V2V cooperation under a standardized simulation environment.
blocks.zh: OpenV2V [21]是一个开放式模拟车辆-车辆合作感知基准,由CARLA和OpenCDA共同构建. 它提供多剂传感器观测,准确的姿势,以及不同交通情景下的合作3D说明,使其适合对车辆车辆特性聚变进行控制评价. 我们使用OpenV2V来检查Sparse2comm是否在标准化模拟环境下将V2V合作泛指多剂.

blocks.en: V2V4Real [ 22 ] is a large-scale real-world vehicle–vehicle cooperative perception dataset collected by two vehicles equipped with multi-modal sensors. It covers 410 km of driving routes and provides 20K LiDAR frames, 40K RGB images, 240K annotated 3D bounding boxes across five classes, and HD maps. We use its cooperative 3D object detection task to test whether Sparse2comm generalizes to real vehicle–vehicle cooperation with moving agents on both sides.
blocks.zh: V2V4Real [22]是一款由两台配备多式传感器的车辆所收集的大型现实世界车辆-车辆合作感知数据集. 它覆盖了410公里的行驶路线并提供了20K LiDAR帧,40K RGB图像,240K注解的3D边框跨5个等级,以及HD地图. 我们利用它合作的3D物体探测任务来测试Sparse2comm是否将车辆一般化为与两侧移动物剂的真正车辆合作.

blocks.en: For all datasets, detection performance is evaluated using Average Precision (AP) at IoU thresholds of 0.5 and 0.7. To assess robustness under practical cooperative perception degradations, we use the same perturbation protocol across methods: (i) packet loss is simulated by randomly masking transmitted features with a ratio r ∼ 𝒰 ⁡ ( 0 , 0.9 ) r\sim\mathcal{U}(0,0.9) ; (ii) transmission delay is simulated by using delayed cooperative features, corresponding to a latency of 200 200 ms; and (iii) spatial misalignment is simulated by adding rotational noise Δ ​ R ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , 3.0 ∘ ) \Delta R\sim\mathcal{N}(0,3.0^{\circ}) and translational noise Δ ​ T ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , 0.5 ) \Delta T\sim\mathcal{N}(0,0.5) m. All compared methods are evaluated under the same feature-transmission protocol without additional compression for fair comparison.

blocks.en: Sparse2comm uses the same sparse feature communication interface, progressive restoration modules, and robustness perturbation protocol across all datasets, with dataset-specific detection ranges and evaluation protocols following the corresponding benchmarks. On DAIR-V2X, we set the point cloud range to [ − 100.8,100.8 ] × [ − 40 , 40 ] × [ − 5 , 3 ] [-100.8,100.8]\times[-40,40]\times[-5,3] meters and the voxel size to 0.4 × 0.4 × 4 0.4\times 0.4\times 4 meters, and evaluate only the Car class. On OpenV2V, we follow the standard LiDAR-based vehicle–vehicle cooperative detection setting, use PointPillars [ 32 ] as the BEV encoder, and evaluate the vehicle category under the official protocol. On V2V4Real, we use the LiDAR-based PointPillars backbone, set the detection region to [ − 100,100 ] [-100,100] meters along the x x axis and [ − 40 , 40 ] [-40,40] meters along the y y axis, merge all vehicle types into one vehicle class, and report AP at IoU thresholds of 0.5 0.5 and 0.7 0.7 . The Sync and Async settings are further included in our unified robustness protocol for packet loss, communication delay, and spatial misalignment. The training follows three stages: collaborator encoder and RPN pre-training, Sparse Feature Encoding pre-training, and end-to-end cooperative fine-tuning. We use Adam [ 55 ] with a learning rate of 0.01 0.01 , a batch size of 6 6 , and 80 80 epochs. For V2V4Real, we train for 60 60 epochs using AdamW with an initial learning rate of 0.001 0.001 , a batch size of 4 4 per GPU, a weight decay of 1 × 10 − 2 1\times 10^{-2} , cosine learning-rate decay, and standard point-cloud augmentations.

blocks.en: IV-C Quantitative Results
blocks.zh: 四-C 量化结果

blocks.en: IV-C 1 Comparison with State-of-the-art
blocks.zh: IV-C 1 与最新技术的比较

blocks.en: We benchmark Sparse2comm on DAIR-V2X [ 1 ] , OpenV2V [ 21 ] , and V2V4Real [ 22 ] , covering dense feature-level cooperation [ 39 , 42 , 40 , 43 ] , communication-efficient methods [ 41 , 8 , 10 , 48 ] , and robustness-oriented methods [ 15 , 18 , 20 ] . Under clean communication, Sparse2comm obtains 69.42/53.78 AP@0.5/AP@0.7 on DAIR-V2X, 93.70/87.66 on OpenV2V, and 71.46/45.36 on V2V4Real. It ranks first on DAIR-V2X, second on OpenV2V behind CoSDH [ 48 ] by only 0.50/0.53 AP, and remains competitive on V2V4Real, showing that sparse communication does not noticeably compromise normal detection accuracy while using only 1.0% relative bandwidth.
blocks.zh: 我们以DAIR-V2X [1],OpenV2V [21],和V2V4 Real [22] 的基准Sparse2comm为基准,涵盖密集的地物级合作[39,42,40,43],通信效率高的方法[41,8,10,48],以及以稳健性为导向的方法[15,18,20]. 在干净的通信下,Sparse2comm获得 69.42/53.78 AP@0.5/AP@0.7,关于DAIR-V2X,93.70/87.66,关于OpenV2V,71.46/45.36,关于V2V4Real。 它在DAIR-V2X上排名第一,在OpenV2V上排名仅以0.50/0.53 AP落后于COSDH [48],在V2V4Real上仍然具有竞争力,表明稀疏的通信不会明显地损害正常的检测精度而只使用1.0%的相对带宽.

blocks.en: The advantage becomes much clearer under the mixed setting, where packet loss, transmission delay, and spatial misalignment occur together. Sparse2comm reaches 58.10/39.54, 88.28/74.53, and 56.18/33.15 AP@0.5/AP@0.7 on the three datasets, improving over the strongest prior results by +15.75/+9.37, +7.13/+4.11, and +11.11/+7.34, respectively. Many dense feature-level baselines drop close to or below No Fusion once cooperative messages are corrupted, while communication-efficient and robustness-oriented methods remain less balanced under coupled disturbances. In contrast, Sparse2comm preserves SOTA-level clean accuracy and achieves the best mixed-setting performance across all datasets, providing a stronger trade-off among accuracy, robustness, and communication efficiency.

blocks.en: IV-C 2 Robustness to Real-world Challenges
blocks.zh: 二. 应对现实世界挑战的能力

blocks.en: We then isolate the three major robustness factors on DAIR-V2X [ 1 ] : packet loss, transmission delay, and spatial misalignment. Table II gives the numerical breakdown, while Fig. 7 traces performance as each disturbance becomes stronger. Sparse2comm achieves the strongest overall robustness across the evaluated disturbances. Under packet loss, it obtains 67.12/50.77 AP@0.5/AP@0.7, outperforming the second-best method, CoDynTrust [ 20 ] , by +10.20/+7.19. Under spatial misalignment, Sparse2comm reaches 63.08/45.39, improving over CoAlign [ 18 ] by +4.06/+1.72, even though CoAlign is specifically designed for pose alignment. Under transmission delay, Sparse2comm achieves the best AP@0.5 and remains close to the best AP@0.7 result, indicating that it maintains competitive temporal robustness while being more balanced across other disturbances.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们将DAIR-V2X [1] 上的三个主要强性因素:包丢失、传输延迟和空间错位。 表二列出数字细目,图7列出每次扰动变强时的性能。 Sparse2comm在经过评估的骚乱中取得了最强的整体稳健性. 在包中丢失,它得到 67.12/50.77 AP@0.5/AP@0.7优于第二好方法CoDynTrust [20],通过+10.20/+7.19。 在空间错位下,Sparse2comm达到63.08/45.39,比CoAlign [18]改进为+4.06/+1.72,尽管CoAlign是专为摆出对齐而设计的. 在传输延迟的情况下,Sparse2comm实现了最佳AP@0.5并仍然接近最佳AP@0.7结果,表明它保持了竞争性的时态稳健性,同时在其他扰动中更加平衡.

blocks.en: The key observation is that existing methods tend to be robust to only one degradation type. How2comm [ 10 ] , CoBEVFlow [ 15 ] , and CoDynTrust [ 20 ] are strong under temporal asynchrony, and CoAlign [ 18 ] is effective under spatial misalignment, but their advantages do not consistently transfer to packet loss or coupled disturbances. The degradation curves make this imbalance clearer: many dense feature-level [ 39 , 42 , 40 , 43 ] and communication-efficient methods [ 41 , 8 , 10 , 48 ] degrade rapidly as disturbance intensity increases, and some even approach or fall below the No Fusion baseline. In contrast, Sparse2comm exhibits a slower performance decay across all three curves and achieves 58.10/39.54 under the mixed setting, surpassing the strongest prior result, CoDynTrust [ 20 ] , by +15.75/+9.37 with only 2.6 Mbps bandwidth. Taken together, the targeted and mixed results support Sparse2comm as a more balanced robustness solution for practical cooperative perception.
blocks.zh: 关键的意见是,现有方法往往只有一种降解类型。 How2comm [10], CoBEVFlow [15], 和 CoDynTrust [20] 在时间同步下是强的, CoAlign [18] 在空间错位下是有效的,但是其优点并没有一致地转移到包丢失或相伴扰动上. 降解曲线使这种不平衡更加明显:许多密集的地物级[39、42、40、43]和通信效率高的方法[41、8、10、48]随着扰动强度的增加而迅速降解,有些甚至接近或低于无聚变基线。 相形之下,Sparse2comm显示所有三道曲线的性能衰减较慢,并在混合设置下达到58.10/39.54,超过了前作最强的结果CoDynTrust [20],比起+15.75/+9.37,带宽只有2.6 Mbps. 总而言之,目标明确和喜忧参半的成果支持Sparse2comm,认为它是促进实际合作观念的更平衡的有力解决办法。

blocks.en: IV-D 5 Efficiency Analysis
blocks.zh: 效率分析

blocks.en: For deployment efficiency, we profile Sparse2comm and the representative baselines under a shared DAIR-V2X setting, using the same machine, BEV range, and inference-stage configuration as in Table VII . In addition to model-side parameters, FLOPs, and pure inference latency, we explicitly account for the communication time required to transmit intermediate cooperative features. Given the transmitted bandwidth BW \mathrm{BW} in Mbps, evaluation frequency f = 10 f{=}10 Hz, and V2X link rate R R , the transmission time is computed as T tx ​ ( R ) = 1000 ​ BW / ( f ​ R ) T_{\mathrm{tx}}(R)=1000\mathrm{BW}/(fR) , and the end-to-end latency is T e2e = T model + T tx T_{\mathrm{e2e}}=T_{\mathrm{model}}+T_{\mathrm{tx}} . We report both a conservative 10 Mbps link and an optimistic 50 Mbps link to reflect practical and high-capacity deployment conditions.

blocks.en: Model-only latency can substantially underestimate the deployment cost of dense feature-level cooperation. Although several full-feature or alignment-based methods have moderate inference latency, their dense communication cost leads to second-level end-to-end latency under a 10 Mbps V2X link. Communication-efficient methods reduce this cost, but their transmitted feature volume remains noticeably higher than Sparse2comm. In contrast, Sparse2comm requires only 2.6 Mbps on DAIR-V2X, reducing the transmission time to 26.0 ms under the conservative 10 Mbps link and 5.2 ms under the 50 Mbps link. Consequently, Sparse2comm achieves 95.7 ms end-to-end latency under 10 Mbps and 74.9 ms under 50 Mbps, while maintaining strong robustness in Table II . The component-level profile in Table VIII further breaks down the computational cost: starting from the object-foreground baseline, SFE, LAA, and SCF each introduce controlled overhead, and the complete system increases latency from 51.2 ms to 69.7 ms. Overall, Sparse2comm offers a favorable system-level trade-off between computation, communication, robustness, and real-time deployment feasibility.

blocks.en: IV-D 6 SFE Architecture

blocks.en: We further vary the SFE encoder–decoder depth in Tab. IX , where N E N_{E} and N D N_{D} denote the number of ViT [ 56 ] blocks in the encoder and decoder, respectively. This ablation evaluates shallow, encoder-heavy, decoder-heavy, and deeper configurations to understand how capacity allocation influences performance under both ideal and noisy conditions.

blocks.en: The alternative SFE designs, including the shallow (S1), encoder-heavy (S2), decoder-heavy (S4), and deeper configuration (S5), do not provide the same balance across clean and noisy settings. Shallow and unbalanced variants either lack sufficient representational capacity or fail to utilize it efficiently, and simply increasing depth does not resolve the robustness issue, as S5 still performs poorly under noise. In contrast, the balanced architecture (S3 with N E = 5 N_{E}{=}5 and N D = 2 N_{D}{=}2 ) obtains the highest accuracy in both ideal and noisy scenarios, reaching 69.42 / 53.78 under ideal conditions and 58.10 / 39.54 under noisy conditions. This pattern suggests that allocating moderate depth to both the encoder and the decoder provides the most effective and robust design for Sparse Feature Encoding.
blocks.zh: 替代性的 SFE 设计,包括浅层(S1),编码器-重层(S2),解码器-重层(S4)和更深层的配置(S5),在干净和吵闹的设置中不能提供相同的平衡. 浅而不平衡的变体要么缺乏足够的代表性能力,要么未能有效地加以利用,而仅仅增加深度并不能解决强性问题,因为S5在噪音下的表现仍然很差。 相形之下,均衡的架构(S3与N E = 5 N_{E}{=}5和N D = 2 N_{D}{=}2)在理想和吵闹两种情景中都获得了最高的准确度,在理想条件下达到69.42/ 53.78,在吵闹条件下达到58.10/ 39.54. 这种图案表明,将中度深度分配到编码器和解码器上,为Sparse地物编码提供了最有效和最坚固的设计.

blocks.en:
Figs. 8 and 9 show representative noisy-condition detections on DAIR-V2X and V2V4Real, respectively. Green/red boxes denote ground-truth/predicted objects, and magenta dashed regions highlight challenging areas.
On DAIR-V2X [ 1 ] , baseline methods often miss compact vehicle clusters or produce spatially shifted boxes, especially for adjacent and partially occluded targets. Sparse2comm detects more vehicles in these crowded regions and aligns the predicted boxes more closely with the ground truth.
On V2V4Real [ 22 ] , noisy communication causes unstable long-range detections and inaccurate orientations along the driving corridor. In contrast, Sparse2comm produces fewer missed detections and more reliable box placement, showing its effectiveness in real-world vehicle–vehicle cooperation.
These comparisons are consistent with Tables I and II , where Sparse2comm improves noisy-condition detection by restoring semantic content, temporal consistency, and spatial alignment before fusion.

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en:
This paper presented Sparse2comm, a bandwidth-efficient and robust cooperative 3D object detection framework for unreliable real-world cooperation. Rather than treating communication reduction, packet loss, temporal delay, and spatial misalignment as separate problems, Sparse2comm formulates them as coupled degradations of cooperative features and addresses them through a progressive feature restoration pipeline. Sparse Feature Encoding builds a compact and recoverable object-centric representation for ultra-low-bandwidth transmission and packet-loss recovery. Latency-Aware Alignment then predicts motion flow from temporal collaborator features to compensate delayed cooperative messages at the ego-vehicle timestamp, while Self-Calibrating Fusion estimates residual pose-induced offsets in a self-supervised manner to refine cross-agent feature correspondence before adaptive fusion.
Experiments on DAIR-V2X [ 1 ] , OpenV2V [ 21 ] , and V2V4Real [ 22 ] show that Sparse2comm maintains competitive clean accuracy and achieves stronger mixed robustness across diverse cooperative perception scenarios. Compared with the representative selective communication baseline Where2comm, Sparse2comm improves mixed-setting AP@0.5/AP@0.7 by +20.15/+11.79 , +12.66/+11.07 , and +15.36/+12.61 on the three datasets, respectively, while using only 1.0% relative feature bandwidth.
blocks.zh:
本文介绍了Sparse2comm,这是一个带宽高效而强大的合作3D对象检测框架,用于不可靠的现实世界合作. Sparse2comm没有将通信减少、数据包丢失、时间延误和空间错位作为单独的问题处理,而是将它们表述为合作特征的结合退化,并通过逐步恢复特征管道加以解决。 Sparse Feature Encoding为超低波段传输和数据包丢失回收建立了一个紧凑且可回收的以对象为中心的代表. 然后,Latency-Aware对接预测从时间合作特性产生的运动流来补偿自负-车辆时间戳上被延迟的合作信息,而自失能融合估计出由剩余姿势引起的抵消,以自我监督的方式在适应性融合之前完善跨剂特征对应.
在DAIR-V2X [1],OpenV2V [21],和V2V4Real [22]上的实验显示,Sparse2comm保持了竞争性的清洁精度并实现了不同合作感知情景的更强的混合强性. 与具有代表性的选择性通信基线Where2comm相比,Sparse2comm将混合设置的AP@0.5/AP@0.7分别改进为+20.15+11.79,+12.66/+11.07,和+15.36/+12.61在三个数据集上,同时仅使用1.0%的相对特征带宽.

blocks.en: Limitation and future work. Sparse2comm currently focuses on cooperative 3D object detection with feature-level communication. Future work will extend the progressive restoration idea to broader cooperative autonomy tasks, such as occupancy perception, trajectory prediction, and end-to-end cooperative driving, and further investigate its deployment behavior under real communication systems with dynamic bandwidth and latency.
blocks.zh: 限制和今后的工作。 Sparse2comm目前专注于合作的有特征级通信的3D对象检测. 未来工作将把渐进恢复的想法扩展至更广泛的合作自主任务,如占用感知,轨迹预测,端到端合作驱动等,并进一步调查其在具有动态带宽和耐用性的真实通信系统下的部署行为.
